name: Northfold Crossing
summary: Northfold Crossing is a strategic junction situated in the rolling hills of the Arathi Highlands. Positioned along critical roadways, it serves as a contested defensive waypoint buffering major regional strongholds.

sections.title: A Contested Intersection
sections.body: Positioned within the windswept Arathi Highlands, Northfold Crossing marks a vital intersection of paths traversing the central plains. In an active war zone caught between ancestral human bastions, aggressive Syndicate brigands, and resurgent orcish settlements, junctions like Northfold are fiercely contested. Whoever controls this ground controls troop movements and supply convoys, making it an inevitable staging ground for skirmishes between the Alliance and the Horde.

faq.answer: Northfold Crossing is a strategic crossroads located in the Arathi Highlands. It guards key transit corridors across the highlands, acting as an outpost and buffer zone for regional strongholds.

faq.q: Why is Northfold Crossing strategically important?
faq.answer: The crossing oversees essential roadways cutting across the Arathi plains. Holding the intersection allows an army to screen the approaches to nearby encampments, protect supply trains, and delay any rival vanguard marching across the highlands.

faq.q: What threats can be found around the crossing?
faq.answer: Beyond hostile patrols from opposing factions, the wild plains around Northfold Crossing are prowled by local fauna, including venomous Plains Creepers and roaming predators.

angles.text: For Alliance forces securing the approaches to Stromgarde and Refuge Pointe, Northfold Crossing is an essential choke point to blunt Horde advances across the highlands.
The Horde relies on the crossroads to screen defensive perimeters and protect critical supply paths moving across central Arathi.
